# weevr

> Configuration-driven execution framework for Spark in Microsoft Fabric.
> Users declare data shaping intent in YAML; a stable PySpark engine
> interprets that intent to execute optimized, repeatable data
> transformations.

## Documentation

- [Docs home](https://ardent-data.github.io/weevr/latest/)
- [Thread YAML schema](https://ardent-data.github.io/weevr/latest/reference/yaml-schema/thread/)
- [Weave YAML schema](https://ardent-data.github.io/weevr/latest/reference/yaml-schema/weave/)
- [Loom YAML schema](https://ardent-data.github.io/weevr/latest/reference/yaml-schema/loom/)
- [Configuration keys](https://ardent-data.github.io/weevr/latest/reference/configuration-keys/)
- [Fabric Runtime](https://ardent-data.github.io/weevr/latest/guides/fabric-runtime/): weevr runs on Runtime 1.3 and Runtime 2.0 (2.0 from 1.21)
- [Execution modes](https://ardent-data.github.io/weevr/latest/concepts/execution-modes/)
- [CLI](https://ardent-data.github.io/weevr-cli/latest/)

## JSON Schema

Machine-readable schema files for LLM and IDE consumption:

- [thread.json](https://github.com/ardent-data/weevr/blob/main/docs/schema/thread.json)
- [weave.json](https://github.com/ardent-data/weevr/blob/main/docs/schema/weave.json)
- [loom.json](https://github.com/ardent-data/weevr/blob/main/docs/schema/loom.json)
- [weevr.json](https://github.com/ardent-data/weevr/blob/main/docs/schema/weevr.json) (combined)
